sql: SELECT y.trip_date, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.trips END) AS target_trips, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' THEN y.trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips FROM whybot.yellow_daily y WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21', DATE '2024-11-28') GROUP BY y.trip_date ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
